dedupe_keys.name: national construction code ncc 2025 australia online code pdfs and machine readable dataset

description: The National Construction Code is Australia's main set of technical design and construction provisions for buildings, a performance-based code setting minimum levels for safety, health, amenity, accessibility and sustainability. It is produced by the Australian Building Codes Board for the Australian Government and the states and territories; NCC 2025 has Volume One (the Building Code of Australia for Class 2 to 9 buildings), Volume Two, Volume Three and the ABCB Housing Provisions Standard, with state and territory adoption notes and an archive of editions back to BCA 1988. Coverage: Australia, as adopted by each state and territory. Access: the volumes are online and as PDFs, and a downloadable NCC 2025 dataset is published on data.gov.au for use in other systems; the ABCB republished it on 24 June 2026 (article updated 30 June) as one document per volume with unique identifiers and errata fixes. Licence: CC BY 4.0, except third party material, trade marks and images; free. Caveats: users who took the dataset after 6 May 2026 are told to replace it. Simulation uses are rule inputs for design checks, building classification and energy and fire provisions in compliance and resilience models. Related records: the ICC digital codes for the United States.
